title: Data Type Adapters
summary: This module provides a collection of custom data types for DSPy, enabling structured representation and seamless integration of various data formats (e.g., audio, images, code, documents, tools) with language models. It defines a base type and specialized adapters for handling complex inputs and outputs.

nodes.label: Define Base Custom Type
nodes.title: dspy.adapters.types.base_type.Type
nodes.description: Provides a foundational class for all custom DSPy data types, defining common interfaces for formatting, serialization, and LM adaptation.

nodes.label: Audio Data Adapter
nodes.title: dspy.adapters.types.audio.Audio
nodes.description: Handles audio data, supporting various input sources (URL, file, array) and encoding it for use with language models.

nodes.label: Code Snippet Adapter
nodes.title: dspy.adapters.types.code.Code
nodes.description: Manages code snippets, allowing specification of programming language and formatting for LLM code generation or analysis tasks.

nodes.label: Document Content Adapter
nodes.title: dspy.adapters.types.document.Document
nodes.description: Represents textual documents with optional metadata, designed for citation-enabled language models to process and reference source material.

nodes.label: Generic File Adapter
nodes.title: dspy.adapters.types.file.File
nodes.description: Encapsulates generic file content, supporting local paths, raw bytes, or file IDs, and formats them for LLM consumption.

nodes.label: Image Data Adapter
nodes.title: dspy.adapters.types.image.Image
nodes.description: Processes image data from various sources (URL, file, PIL object), encoding it for multimodal language model inputs.

nodes.label: LLM Tool Definition
nodes.title: dspy.adapters.types.tool.Tool
nodes.description: Wraps Python functions to define tools for LLMs, inferring signatures and enabling structured function calling and integration with external tool frameworks.

nodes.label: Citation Management
nodes.title: dspy.adapters.types.citation.Citations
nodes.description: Manages structured citation information, allowing conversion from various formats and formatting for LLM output.

nodes.label: Tool Call Management
nodes.title: dspy.adapters.types.tool.ToolCalls
nodes.description: Handles structured tool call information, validating and parsing tool call inputs for LLM interactions.

nodes.label: Extract File Extension
nodes.title: dspy.adapters.types.image._get_file_extension
nodes.description: Utility to determine the file extension from a given path or URL.

nodes.label: Validate Image Object
nodes.title: dspy.adapters.types.image.is_image
nodes.description: Checks if an object represents valid image data or a reference to an image file/URL.

nodes.label: Pydantic Library
nodes.title: Pydantic Library
nodes.description: Provides data validation and settings management using Python type hints.

nodes.label: Language Model System
nodes.title: Language Model System
nodes.description: Represents the underlying Large Language Model that consumes and produces structured data.

nodes.label: Local File System
nodes.title: Local File System
nodes.description: Provides access to local files for reading and writing operations.

nodes.label: Network Services
nodes.title: Network Services
nodes.description: Enables downloading resources from URLs and other network operations.

nodes.label: Pillow Image Library
nodes.title: Pillow Image Library
nodes.description: Used for image manipulation and processing (e.g., PIL.Image objects).

nodes.label: Soundfile Library
nodes.title: Soundfile Library
nodes.description: Handles reading and writing sound files, particularly for audio array processing.

nodes.label: LangChain Framework
nodes.title: LangChain Framework
nodes.description: Provides tools and abstractions for building applications with LLMs, including tool integration.

nodes.label: MCP Framework
nodes.title: MCP Framework
nodes.description: An external framework for managing and converting tools.

groups.label: Base Type Definition
groups.title: Base Type Definition
groups.description: Defines the foundational `Type` class for all custom DSPy data structures, providing a consistent interface for data handling and LM integration.

groups.label: Multimedia Adapters
groups.title: Multimedia Adapters
groups.description: Handles various multimedia data types like audio, images, and generic files, converting them into formats suitable for language model processing.

groups.label: Text and Code Adapters
groups.title: Text and Code Adapters
groups.description: Manages structured text content, code snippets, and citation information, preparing them for LLM input and output.

groups.label: Tooling Adapters
groups.title: Tooling Adapters
groups.description: Facilitates the definition and management of tools for LLMs, enabling structured function calling and integration with external tool frameworks.

groups.label: Helper Utilities
groups.title: Helper Utilities
groups.description: Provides auxiliary functions for tasks such as file extension extraction and image object validation, supporting the core adapters.
